one_line: A Neolithic tooth-driller and community healer from Mehrgarh and the early Indus towns, working with simple tools and emerging public water systems.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean and wiry with sturdy arms from manual work.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, faint lines at the eyes from concentration, and a calm, focused default expression that softens when treating patients.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight dark-brown hair tied into a low shoulder-length ponytail with a narrow woven reed band, front kept tidy with a simple center part, no metal headwear.
appearance.costume: A knee-length undyed off-white cotton tunic with half sleeves and a simple straight cut, belted at the waist with a light-brown leather thong, worn over a slightly darker buff-coloured woven cloth dhoti-style lower wrap that reaches the shins; feet in plain brown leather sandals; a narrow, faded reddish-brown wool shawl draped over the left shoulder for warmth and to wipe hands; minimal jewellery limited to one small, pale-green stone bead necklace and a single terracotta-bead bracelet on the right wrist, all textiles looking hand-spun with subtle irregular weave but no elaborate patterns.
appearance.signature: A short hand-held dental drill made from a smooth light-brown wooden shaft with a simple bow-string, tipped with a tiny dark stone point, carried along with a small woven reed basket containing extra stone points and pebbles, always in his left hand or hanging from his belt.

ref_desc: Mehrgarh Dental Healer: mid-30s lean man with medium-brown skin, calm oval face, dark-brown ponytail bound with a reed band, wearing off-white cotton tunic, buff wrap, reddish-brown shawl, simple bead jewellery, and carrying a wooden bow dental drill with stone tip and reed basket in earthy browns and pale green accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a shonen-anime style full-body model of the “Mehrgarh Dental Healer”: a mid-30s lean man with medium-brown complexion, an oval face, focused but gentle eyes, and a calm, concentrated expression; his thick dark-brown hair is parted in the center and tied into a low shoulder-length ponytail with a narrow woven reed band, no metal headwear. Dress him in a modest, historically plausible early Neolithic Indus outfit: a knee-length off-white hand-spun cotton tunic with half sleeves and simple straight cut, belted at the waist with a light-brown leather thong; beneath it a slightly darker buff-brown woven cloth lower wrap in a dhoti-like style reaching the shins; on his feet plain brown leather sandals. Over his left shoulder drape a narrow, faded reddish-brown wool shawl used as a working cloth, and add minimal jewellery: a single pale-green stone bead necklace and a simple terracotta bead bracelet on his right wrist. His signature prop is a short hand-held dental drill made from a smooth light-brown wooden shaft with a bow-string and a tiny dark stone point, accompanied by a small woven reed basket with extra stone points and pebbles, carried in his left hand or hanging from his belt. Use a muted earthy palette of off-white, buff brown, reddish brown, dark brown, and pale green, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize the fixed ponytail, tunic, wrap, shawl, sandals, bead jewellery, and wooden bow drill with stone tip and reed basket, all fully clothed and suitable for an all-ages historical anime style.
